'''Ryu''' (Japanese: '''リュウ''' ''Ryū''), known as '''Ron''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is a character from [[Pokémon Adventures]] and is [[Clair]]'s disciple.

==History==
Ryu was first seen having a battle with his master, Clair. Although he fought hard, [[Clair's Dragonair]] managed to easily defeat his {{p|Seadra}} and won the battle. Although she stated that Ryu needed more training before he could defeat her, Clair praised his use of {{m|Twister}} and {{m|Smokescreen}} to block her vision. When Clair notes that a worthy challenger hasn't come by in a while, Ryu brings up the fact that only her cousin [[Lance]] was able to best her in battle. This angers Clair, who proceeds to kick Ryu in the face.

Ryu makes a cameo appearance in a flashback in ''[[PS445|Dealing With A Koffing Fit]]'', where he overhears Clair's conversation with Lance over the [[Pokégear]].

==Character==
Ryu was considered to be interested in [[Clair]] as seen when he mentioned about her family history.
